what_changed: PO-5520 (200 BL-12 boilers, originally due day 7) will now ship either as 80 units on day 7 plus 120 units on day 21 (Option A), or as all 200 units on day 13 (Option B), per the supplier's offer.

decisions_for_a_person: Choose between Option A (puts order O-2205, 4 days late, at risk) and Option B (puts order O-2203, 1 day late, at risk) — both at-risk orders carry a late penalty, so weigh which delay/penalty is more acceptable.
Respond to Marlow Metalworks within three business days, or Option B will be applied by default.
